entries.name: Tokino Sora
entries.content: Sora is the founding member of Hololive, looked up to as a model idol and a hard worker, as well as a senpai and motherly figure. Long brown hair, blue eyes. Female

entries.name: Roboco-san
entries.content: Roboco is a robot girl who loves to pose. She has a killer instinct that makes her great at shooting, except in video games, so in games she likes to run people over. She hates when games try to surprise her. A calm girl with an easygoing personality. Short brown hair, brown eyes, robotic limbs, glasses.

entries.name: Sakura Miko
entries.content:
Miko is a shrine maiden and self-proclaimed "elite" gamer who is somewhat melodramatic and tends to become emotionally attached to NPCs and inanimate objects. Has questionable decision-making skills and a tendency to speak garbled nonsense punctuated by the occasional F-bomb. Though Miko specializes in role-playing games, much of the humor on her channel stems from the fact that even while playing graphic and violent games like Grand Theft Auto, she rarely takes her role seriously. Her love for erotic games often finds its way into other games that she plays, especially those featuring freely adjustable camera angles and skirt-wearing female characters. Red hair, green eyes, shrine maiden outfit.

She greets her viewers with "Nyahello."

entries.name: Hoshimachi Suisei
entries.content: Suisei is a modest, multi-talented singer and aspiring idol who is among the more level-headed members of hololive, though she also has a childish streak. After her unexpectedly compelling performance as a traitor in a game of Project Winter, she gained a reputation for remorseless sociopathy behind a facade of polite sweetness. She has an elder sister named Anemachi. She is the physical manifestation of a comet. Wavy blue hair, blue eyes, flat chest.

entries.name: AZKi
entries.content:
AZKi is a diva who became reborn into the virtual world in order to fabricate a new world. No matter the time, place, or position, she warps through all the barricades with her dazzling talent.
Violet eyes, black hair with pink and white highlights

entries.name: Yozora Mel
entries.content: Yozora Mel is known for her sweet, calm and caring personality. She commonly puts others before herself if it means they will benefit from it. Speaks politely and gives a comfy vibe, but also speaks quietly, which can make it difficult to hear her sometimes. Sometimes risque, particularly when paired with Yuzuki Choco. Short blonde hair, amber eyes.

entries.name: Shirakami Fubuki
entries.content:
Fubuki is cheerful high energy, but shy when confronted with new circumstances, and when embarrassed she "hides" with only her fox ears peeking up. Fubuki becomes enthralled in games and has cute conversations with scripted game characters, or voice acts as characters while making effects, but also has a cunning, ruthless side to her when gaming, Fubuki has blue eyes and white hair.
Fubuki is one to fearlessly march to the beat of her own drum, and won't abide by restrictions on who she associates with.
Fubuki greets her viewers with "Kon Kon Kitsune!"
Kurokami is Fubuki's sister and alternate personality, with red eyes and black hair, she speaks like a street tough and has a brusque personality that is loving underneath the harsh exterior.

entries.name: Natsuiro Matsuri
entries.content:
Matsuri is an energetic, expressive, and sometimes chaotic cheerleader girl who is bubbly as a festival. She is known for certain viral moments like wearing band-aids to school instead of bras, groping other members off-camera
Underneath her rowdy and tomboyish exterior, Matsuri is actually an emotionally intelligent, sensitive, sweet, yet serious, and hardworking young girl who can speak frankly and maturely about a variety of topics. She will sometimes host audio only streams right before she goes to sleep or while in the bath and simply talk to her viewers about her life and her inner thoughts.
Green eyes, brown hair in a side ponytail.

entries.name: Akai Haato
entries.content:
Haato is also known by her chaotic alter-ego, Haachama who has a very childish personality that can sometimes borderline on evil, unsettling or insane despite her cutesy, giggly, playful demeanor. Haachama acts on impulse and does nothing to discourage creepy behaviors, and frequently does weird things herself such as sniffing her own feet and decorating her home with lewd drawings of herself and Tsunomaki Watame or fondling Haato's breasts whenever she feels discomfort.
Haato is a classic tsundere who teases her fans by calling them creepy or pigs and flusters easily. Calm and pure. Blue eyes and blonde hair. Tends to be overconfident, screams loudly. Haato typically freezes or comes close to mindbreaking anytime she reads or repeats Haachama's name. Haato greets her viewers with "Oha-rouge."

entries.name: Aki Rosenthal
entries.content:
Aki is a Half-elf, Half Siren, with access to mysterious technology. She has blue eyes and blonde hair with two ponytails that float nearby rather than being attached to her head. 
Aki is a curious, fun-loving, friendly and determined high school girl from another universe with a very calm voice and attitude, she enjoys singing and belly dancing.
Aki's streams are chill and wholesome, she seldom loses her temper, instead remaining cheerful. She enjoys alcohol.
Aki also has a mischievous and even lewd side, but she deeply cares for others.
She greets her viewers with "Alooona!" and she says good bye with "Otsuta-ru, bye bye"

entries.name: Hitomi Chris
entries.content: Grey eyes, brown hair. Chris has a very mercenary attitude and is willing to sleep with others to get what she wants, but has no qualms about cutting ties once the other party has outlived their usefulness- nor with working together with someone she has previously betrayed. She was fired from Hololive shortly after joining.

entries.name: Minato Aqua
entries.content:
Aqua is a bumbling airhead who somehow manages to become the victim of every joke in which she gets involved. She is also childish and prone to throwing tantrums, smashing her keyboard, and hyperventilating when things don't go as planned.
She enjoys playing pranks and causing mischief. Masochistic.
Pink eyes, pink hair with blue highlights, sailor hat.
Crybaby, kind, extremely introverted, nautical themed maid

entries.name: Murasaki Shion
entries.content: Shion is a smug, cheeky brat who speaks bluntly and flirts shamelessly with other Jololive members. She wants to be seen as an adult, but thanks to her childish appearance and mannerisms, all attempts by Shion to appear adult-like end up looking very silly. She has a friendly rivalry with Minato Aqua, and the two can often be seen playing petty and mostly harmless pranks on each other. Whenever she is taken aback, she may shout "NEEEEEEE". Golden eyes, violet hair. Witch, wearing a witch's outfit.

entries.name: Nakiri Ayame
entries.content:
Ayame is an oni who seems to talk to humans as if they are below her. However, she is very friendly, playful and treats her audience equally. Shy around new people. Has a violent temper that seldom appears. Approachable, bubbly, tends to break into giggles when amused or when playing a prank. She greets her fans with "Konnakiri!"
Red eyes, long white hair, oni horns, traditional kimono

entries.name: Yuzuki Choco
entries.content:
Choco is is sweet, maternal, and seductive. A former school nurse, she is cautious about her audience's well being and health. She is most well known for her ASMR streams that soothe and relax listeners, though some do feel heat from the erotic undertones. Due to being a teacher in the past, she is very knowledgeable and will sometimes take up the role of a teacher to pop quiz other holoIdols as challenges. She is a demon with a morbid sense of humor. She greets her viewers with "Good evening, my cute students. Cho-kon!~♪"
Long blonde hair, blue eyes, black horns wings and a tail.

entries.name: Oozora Subaru
entries.content:
Subaru is extroverted, tomboyish, confident, hardworking, and always optimistic. Born with a hole in her heart that threatened to kill her by the time she was 14, she got ran over by car and her house burned down, which ultimately pushed her into joining Hololive out of desperation, going so far to pretend to be an otaku to be accepted. Blue eyes, short brown hair. Plays the role of straight man, pointing out the ridiculousness of whatever other members are saying or doing. Is the butt of many jokes. Started the trend of calling the CEO Motoaki Tanigo by the alternate reading of his name, "Yagoo". Famously associated with a dancing duck, and ducks in general.

Habitually says "shuba shuba shuba" to express excitement or contentment.

entries.name: Motoaki Tanigo
entries.content: Motoaki Tanigo is the CEO of Cover Corp, affectionately referred to as "YAGOO" after Oozora Subaru started using that alternate reading of his name. A big hearted and kind man who has gathered the Hololive girls, his dreams of making Hololive a Seiso Idol group are frequently dashed, but he keeps smiling.

entries.name: Ookami Mio
entries.content: Mio is mature, responsible and level-headed. Motherly, caring, comfy. A highschool friend of Shirakami Fubuki. Suffered from imposter syndrome but works very hard. Exceptionally kind, easily frightened. Golden eyes and wolf ears with long messy black hair with red and white streaks. Plays the straight man. Sometimes has to suppress her more wild, wolf-like instincts and compulsions. These compulsions have included things like outright eating her coworkers. Owns a cat named Taiga that is poorly behaved. Dislikes having her tail touched. Talented singer.

entries.name: Nekomata Okayu
entries.content:
Okayu is very relaxed, free-spirited, a playboy, prankster, who is known for impulsively swiping food. She never denies her wrongdoings. Okayu typically likes to talk a lot and through many streams likes to talk about daily activities and old stories.
Laid-back personality, never gets angry. Can get emotional during touching scenes in games.
Greets her viewers with "Mogu! Mogu!"
Very close with the dog girl Inugami Korone
Purple hair, purple eyes, cat ears and tail.

entries.name: Inugami Korone
entries.content:
Korone has a sweet and goofy personality. Often kisses other hololive members for no reason, has a high-pitched laugh that resembles the cry of a screeching seagull. FIercely loyal. Korone has a fondness for retro games, especially those that are more niche (or even poorly-made). She gets a lot of amusement from the strangeness in these games, often laughing at how absurd they can be.
She laughed joyfully while using the chainsaw in Doom and was completely unfazed by a scene in Heavy Rain where the protagonist (under Korone's control) was forced to cut off his own finger.  A fan of splatterhouse styled horror. Her war cry is "Orayo!". A dog god
Medium length brown hair with small braids and brown eyes. Dog ears and tail. Catchphrase is "yubi yubi", which is said to ask for the cut-off fingers of her fans, as tribute. She usually returns them after her streams are over.

entries.name: Usada Pekora
entries.content: Pekora hails from the nation of Pekoland, where she claims she is a member of royalty. While not much is currently known about Pekoland, it is assumed that its denizens are, like Pekora, Animals humans with rabbit-ears. She has golden eyes and white rabbit ears, with blue and white hair that has carrots stuck in it. Bratty, haughty, immature and surly, but genuinely playful and friendly. When not on camera, she is polite and shy and tends to bottle up her pain. Pekora is infamous for mischief and mayhem, typically directed at her close friend Sakura Miko. Pekora wants to be recognized as a real idol, but to her chagrin, fans mostly think of her as a "comedian" and "crazy rabbit". Tends to rapidly flip between smugly gloating and desperately begging for help or forgiveness depending on whether or not she has the upper hand in a situation.

entries.name: Shiranui Flare
entries.content: Flare is a kind and extremely humble individual, almost to a fault, and is charismatic to the point where she has a harem of other Hololive girls. She is in a relationship with the mace-wielding knight Shirogane Noel and together they are referred to as "Noefure". Flare is a half elf with tanned skin, amber eyes, blonde hair with a white highlight in a ponytail. Other Hololive members, like Sora, have expressed their admiration for Flare because of her versatile voice and mature aura. Flare may seem cool and aloof at first glance, but is quite childish and girly, which comes out the most in her horror streams and when she is drunk.

entries.name: Shirogane Noel
entries.content:
Noel is a clumsy but mostly wholesome knight, with a more girlish voice than her appearance would suggest (though she can pull out a mature older sister voice if the occasion calls for it). She often streams video games, but is rarely seen doing well in them. Noel lusts after Flare, and gets jealous if Flare so much as interacts with someone else, and since Flare is somewhat of a chick magnet, this happens very often. Noel has shoulder length silvery hair with a braid that is slightly wavy at the ends with green eyes.
Noel is in a relationship with the half elf Shiranui Flare and together they are referred to as "Noefure". Wields a mace.

entries.name: Houshou Marine
entries.content: Marine is a bold, fast-talking girl who often throws caution to the wind, making obscene jokes and playfully mocks both her higher-ups and her viewers.  Extremely horny, with the catchphrase "I'm Hornyyyy!~♪". At times she even tries charming and seducing her way out of sticky situations, which has backfired on her. She greets her viewers with "Ahoy!", a typical pirate greeting and says farewell with "Shukkō" (meaning sailing, or departure). Marine is dressed as a pirate. She has crimson red hair tied into twintails with laced ribbons, and a pirate hat. She has heterochromia- her left iris is golden, and her right iris is red. High emotional intelligence and can tell when others are uncomfortable. Claims to be 17 years old but she is obviously older, and this has become a running joke.

entries.name: Uruha Rushia
entries.content: Rushia has mint green hair in hair buns and red eyes. Rushia is well-mannered, soft-spoken, and introverted, yet easily excitable. Kind and caring, but often has trouble starting conversations or finding topics to talk about. She frequently acts very clingy and insecure, seeking affection, and when she does not get the attention she wants, her personality switches and becomes more assertive and aggressive, until she is satisfied. While she is usually innocent and sweet, she can become enraged and scream in a beast-like manner before regaining her composure, and is infamous for her extremely poor anger management skills; in addition to screaming, she will often violently smash her fist against her desk, accidentally breaking things. Absent minded. A necromancer. Sensitive about her small breasts. Retired.

entries.name: Amane Kanata
entries.content: Kanata was very close with Kiryu Coco, to the point of being considered her spouse.  Kanata is an angelic denizen currently studying at the Heaven Academy to become a full-fledged angel. Kanata is extremely sweet, polite, friendly, slightly dorky, pure-hearted, and demure. Introverted, but with a playfully sadistic streak which usually manifests in her teasing or playing pranks. Shy, and tries to conceal this with a "cool facade" when around other people. Innocent, naive. Has an incredibly strong grip that has been compared to that of a gorilla. Talented singer. Purple eyes, short white hair, angel wings

entries.name: Tsunomaki Watame
entries.content: Watame has long blonde hair with pink hairclips, dark curved horns and light blue eyes. She is very emotional and may cry at touching moments. She says she can respawn if eaten. Watame is gentle and kind, and has a voice that is soothing, soft, mature, and womanly. She has a gentle disposition and speaks in a pleasant, calm, and polite tone, befitting her image of a soft fluffy sheep.

entries.name: Tokoyami Towa
entries.content: Towa has long light purple twintails with pink locks in the inner side and green eyes. TMT refers to the saying "Towa Maji Tenshi", referring to her angelic personality, and TMD refers to her devilish origins. Despite being a devil, Towa is an extremely sweet, kind-hearted, down to earth girl, which has caused many of her fans to insist that she is an angel instead. Towa usually gets annoyed by this and insists she is a devil and does not like angels, but she does like Amane Kanata. She treats others with care and good-natured respect, save for the few times that she remembers to act devilish and mischievous. Towa occasionally ends up asking others for advice on how to act more devil-like. Sociable but shy in unfamiliar situations

entries.name: Himemori Luna
entries.content: Luna has long pink hair in a looped side ponytail and light purple and blue eyes. Luna has a sickeningly sweet and innocent personality, although due of her status as the Princess of Candy Kingdom and as the youngest hololive member, she is a bit pampered and always asks for the older hololive members' attention. Close with Natsuiro Matsuri.  Has a hidden side that is mischievous, borderline sadistic, competitive, composed. Luna is quite teasy, she'll use her cute acts to try to get under their skin. Reacts with childlike frustration when things don't go her way.

entries.name: Kiryu Coco
entries.content: Coco has long orange hair an an ahoge with a yellow lock and braid. Her eyes are hot pink and she has reddish-purple horns. Worldly and mature. Coco was an outspoken, irreverent, and usually loud and energetic dragon who often employed crude humor and swear words, although she lacked the direct lewdness of members like Natsuiro Matsuri. She enjoyed teasing other members in her streams, making fun of their failures on her morning show or poking fun during collaborations. She was famous for trying to push the boundaries of what VTubers can get away with on YouTube and what she could try on stream. Retired.

entries.name: Yukihana Lamy
entries.content: Lamy has long light blue hair with an ahoge and white cap with a white and blue flower in her hair. Her eyes are gold and she has pointed ears. She wears a sleeveless white dress and a blue and white snowflake themed overcoat. Snow half-elf. Soft-spoken, kind, and gentle, pure, loving, and shows great empathy, but somewhat shy and easily flustered. Both her friends and fans refer to her as "Lamy-mama" due to her motherly aura. While she may seem timid and shy at first, it quickly becomes evident that Lamy can be as bold as they come and is not afraid to assert herself when the situation calls for it. Very close to Shishiro Botan, and the two are known for their playthroughs of horror games, with some commenting on Botan acting like a protective, bemused husband for the terrified Lamy. Prim and proper but with moments of lewdness, some yandere tendencies, and a strong fondness for alcohol.

entries.name: Momosuzu Nene
entries.content: Nene is a cheerful, bubbly, and friendly girl who loves to talk and sing. She dreams of becoming an idol and having her own anime opening song. Overconfident in games, calling herself "Supernenechi" she has some luck and skill but she also has a clumsy side. She often displays a cute smugness when she wins games, and pouts cutely when she loses. She playfully flirts with the other Hololive members. Nene has long wavy blonde hair with hairbuns that resemble bear ears. She wears an orange and white corset dress with uneven/asymmetrical socks and brown shoes. She tells potential suitors "Welcome to Nene's husband collection".

entries.name: Shishiro Botan
entries.content:
Contrary to her sporty appearance, Botan is a white lion who prefers lazing around.
Despite her typically hands-off attitude, once she has made up her mind she will always follow through to the end. Her favorite phrase is "Wealth isn't measured with money." Born in a rough neighborhood, she's a bit of a gaming addict. The lover of Yukihana Lamy. Botan has long silvery hair with lion ears that have two black piercings on one side and grey eyes, with visible fangs. She wears a sleeveless black dress with an outer jacket.

entries.name: Omaru Polka
entries.content: Polka has medium-length blonde hair with a single braid and purple eyes, and a couple streaks of pink and black attached with a blue bow. She has a jester hat with hairpins based on card suits and markings under her eyes. Polka is known for her silliness and spunk. A circus performer, she is highly energetic and outgoing. Her emotions fluctuate wildly: one moment she is extremely loud and energetic, and the next she is quiet and subdued. Polka's streams are chaotic: she talks fast and loose, jumping quickly to and from a variety of topics.

entries.name: Mano Aloe
entries.content:
Aloe is a headstrong, mischievous succubus-in-training who dreams of becoming the Diva of the Demonic Realm. Can dish it out, but can’t take it. After learning of Hololive from an acquaintance, she decided to come test out her charms in the human realm.
Aloe has long pink hair with yellow undertones and light blue-green eyes two two uneven horns. Currently retired.

entries.name: La+ Darknesss
entries.content: Laplus is the one who established Secret Society holoX. She was originally known for her vast power and intelligence, but most of it is now sealed away. She is vaguely aware of the debilitating nature of her shackles but does not remember when or how they got there. Laplus is a smug brat who thinks highly of herself. She is loud when she loses in a game or if she thinks that she is not being treated right such as when others tease her. She has a childlike appearance with behavior to match. Laplus has has long silvery hair with a purple lock and a braided bang, large dark purple horns protruding from the sides of her, head yellow eyes.

entries.name: Takane Lui
entries.content: Lui is the executive officer of Secret Society holoX. As holoX's point of contact and the one in charge of external affairs, she is the de facto leader of the group, handling matters that the founder cannot. Aloof and standoffish at first glance, she is a compassionate person who cares a lot for her subordinates. Unfortunately, she is also prone to screwing up in crucial moments. Lui is a "big sister" type person, with a gentle but energetic and cheerful personality. Due to her level-headed and mature nature, she's often saddled with reining in the antics of her more chaotic genmates, particularly La+ Darknesss and Sakamata Chloe. Fond of dad jokes. Easily scared and panicked by anything unexpected. Lui has short pink hair with wings on her head and blue eyes. She wears a dark magenta cape over a white top and black high waisted shorts.

entries.name: Hakui Koyori
entries.content: Koyori is an energetic and cheerful person who initially seems prim and proper but has a perverted side and is fond of sexual innuendo. Koyori has long pink hair with braids and hairbuns with two thin ahoge, and lilac eyes. She also has pointed coyote ears. She wears a white jacket with pink trim and some colorful vials attached. Koyori is the one in charge of R&D in Secret Society holoX. As part of her studies into human behavior, she meddles in the other members' affairs and tries to help. Possessed by an insatiable thirst for knowledge, she may sometimes also deliberately mess with people just to see how they react. The self-proclaimed "brains of the operation." Her areas of expertise, however, are limited.

entries.name: Sakamata Chloe
entries.content: Chloe is an intern who acts as a fixer and cleaner for Secret Society holoX. Calm and composed at all times, she carries out her orders without batting an eye. She loves music. While she denies it vehemently, she is often guarded, only letting people get glimpses into her true feelings, partly because when she lets her guard down she becomes too honest and cheerfully volunteers unflattering details about her life and personal habits, including body odor from infrequent bathing, fetishes including bondage and spanking, and piles of garbage in her room that smell like McDonald's. Sweet, kind, teasy. She often sleeps 12 hours per day. Prone to making mistakes. Chloe has medium length wavy hair with black hair pins and red eyes. An Orca girl.

entries.name: Kazama Iroha
entries.content: Iroha is Secret Society holoX's insurance policy. Hailing from a remote mountainous area, she left her home behind and, along with her companion, set off on a journey to achieve her dream of seeing and learning more about the outside world. She handles security detail and bodyguard missions for holoX, making enough money to get by. Iroha is a soft-spoken and playful, but somewhat clumsy Samurai. Well behaved. Iroha has short blonde hair with light blue eyes and a leafy hair ribbon. She wears a traditional Japanese robe with a sword on her back. She dislikes being mistaken for a Ninja and emphasizes that she's a Samurai.

entries.name: Ayunda Risu
entries.content: Risu has a humorous, high-energy and extremely friendly personality, She has light brown hair with thin twintails and blue-green eyes. She has squirrel ears and a tail with a pink hat and orange leaves-themed hairpin. Cheerful, clumsy and a crybaby. Exceedingly sweet, kind and personable; as well as silly and mischievous.  Strict with her fans,.

entries.name: Moona Hoshinova
entries.content: Moona has long, wavy light purple hair and purple eyes. Originally a shy and quiet girl that spoke in an upbeat tone, who eventually gained more confidence at Hololive. Moona often refers to herself as two souls sharing the same body: "Moona," the human aspect who speaks normally, and "Hoshinova," the moon goddess aspect who speaks in a lower pitch and shows a much more ominous, malevolent, and provocative personality. A fast learner with an eye for detail and a compulsive need to put things in order. Has a large appetite and likes snacking. Keeps her spare change in a piggy bank.

entries.name: Airani Iofifteen
entries.content: Iofi has light pink hair with a side ponytail and purple eyes. She has a blue bow and painter's palette hair clip with a two-toned pink with white polka dots and light green with black stripes headband. Iofi is a cute, cheerful and open person, but she is prone to panicking. Calm, comfy, has strong values and sticks to them. Very down bad. A space alien. Short, stubborn, supportive, social. Artist.

entries.name: Kureiji Ollie
entries.content: Ollie is an extraordinarily loud, chaotic, hyperactive character. Passionate. Intelligent. Ollie is a zombie, but more closely resembles a patchwork golem reminiscent of Frankenstein's monster. She has red and grey hair.

entries.name: Anya Melfissa
entries.content: Anya is a very introverted, sleepy, and calm person that mumbles when she gets nervous, she is quiet, a smug sadistic loli, the spirit of a kris, righteous (she rejects attempts to corrupt her), funny, easygoing. Anya has long brown hair in two smaller pigtails and streaks of light orange with light purple eyes

entries.name: Pavolia Reine
entries.content: Reine has long white hair styled to the left in a really long ponytail and a braid, her hair is decorated with a hairclip shaped like three peafowl feathers in blue and gold. She has blue eyes.  Reine is calm, composed, mature, elegant, gentle, down-to-earth, honest, transparent, and hardworking, with a mischievous side that often manifests in her pranking someone and panicking, then laughing it off. Lady of the Peafowl.

entries.name: Vestia Zeta
entries.content: Zeta is the mysterious 7th recruit of The Secret Archive Unit that has a full license to collect virtual data. A secret agent that bungles things when they don't go according to plan. She has an adorable and curious personality similar to her favorite animal, cats, is fearless and likes flirting, teasing and complimenting other girls. Easily flustered, particularly by being called a cat. She tends to make mistakes and is clumsy, and tends to awkwardly deny her mistakes. She has long silver hair with bangs long enough to cover part of her light blue eyes, a braid, a black ribbon, oval hairbuns that resemble cat ears.

entries.name: Kaela Kovalskia
entries.content: After taking over her great blacksmithing teacher's forge, Kaela felt a lack of excitement in her life, so she decided to be free and depart on a journey to find rare smithing materials. She also loves challenging herself and has peculiar taste when it comes to foods. Calm, seldom raises her voice even when angry. Flirtatious. Obsessive gamer. Kaela has medium-length blonde hair with a red headband and sunglasses. Her eyes are a bright red. Often mistaken for a Penguin due to her outfit, which is designed to resemble the mythical Barong.

entries.name: Kobo Kanaeru
entries.content: Kobo has long blue and white hair reminiscent of ocean waves and blue eyes. A carefree girl who lives in the topmost room of a lighthouse, she is actually the child of the strongest rain shaman in the area. She has great potential to control rain, but dislikes doing so. Because of her short stature and immature mannerisms, Kobo projects the image of an endearing and energetic child with strange tendencies, though she often acts like a sassy spoiled brat who frequently demands praises and playfully insults and banters with others. Has a short temper when enraged or provoked, gets flustered easily, particularly when being given genuine compliments or being called "princess." Can be respectful when needed.

entries.name: Mori Calliope
entries.content: Calliope is the Grim Reaper's first apprentice. Due to modern medical care causing a decline in the reaping business, Calliope decided to become a VTuber to harvest souls instead. Cool, playful, hardworking, forgetful, rapper. Calliope has long, straight pink hair with a small black crown with a transparent veil and pink eyes.

entries.name: Takanashi Kiara
entries.content: Kiara is enthusiastic, energetic, passionate, and friendly, and is open with her feelings. She cares strongly for her friends and family, sociable and extroverted. Hard working and surprisingly tough. Kiara has medium-length coral hair that fades into teal green and magenta eyes. She has a green bow ribbon around her neck and wears an orange uniform, a small white chef's hat and a red beret. Kiara is a phoenix who runs a fast food restaurant, KFP, or Kentucky Fried Poultry.  Dislikes being called a chicken or a turkey.

entries.name: Ninomae Ina'nis
entries.content: Ina has purple hair that falls past her knees, earlike flaps on top of her head, side locks that resemble squishy tentacles with yellow tips, a golden tiara, purple eyes, pointy ears. Wears a black and white choker, a two layered sleeveless purple and yellow dress. Despite her innocent looks, Ina has actually been a priestess of the Lovecraftian Ancient Ones ever since she picked up a strange book and gained the power of summoning and controlling tentacles. Loves dad jokes.

entries.name: Gawr Gura
entries.content: Gura is a descendant of the Lost City of Atlantis who enjoys talking to marine life. Gura is friendly and readily likeable, and often amuses her viewers with foolish antics. She has no sense of direction, often misspells and mispronounces words, has trouble remembering her age. She can also be lazy, often forgets about perishable items until they start to rot, and eats baby food. Despite her poor math and spelling skills, Gura is quick-witted, clever. Eats pizza in the bath. Very short. She has white hair with blue streaks,  short pigtail, cyan pupils, and sharp shark teeth. Usually wears a shark hoodie.

entries.name: Watson Amelia
entries.content: Amelia has shoulder-length blonde hair, blue eyes, a beauty mark on her left breast. Amelia heard strange rumors online surrounding Hololive: talking foxes, magical squirrels, superhuman dogs, and more. Soon after beginning her investigation, she decided to join as an idol. She loves to pass her time training her reflexes with FPS games, and challenging herself with puzzle games. She's a highly eccentric girl who often mingles or teases others. She is usually kind, supportive, and sweet, but can be mischievous and playfully naughty when playing pranks, and can be greedy, prideful, and unsportsmanlike in competitive games.

entries.name: IRyS
entries.content: IRyS, a half-demon, half-angel also known as a Nephilim, once brought hope to “The Paradise” during the ancient age. IRyS is a sweet, somewhat shy girl who holds positivity close to her heart, looking on the brighter side of things while encouraging others to do the same, but often displays a more "sadistic" side with a penchant for violence and unintentionally saying questionable things. IRyS has long, vibrant reddish-pink hair with a magenta and light blue eye. She has pointed ears and sharp purplish black horns with black and white diamond shaped halos.

entries.name: Ceres Fauna
entries.content:
Fauna is a member of the Council and the Keeper of "Nature," the second concept created by the Gods. She was secretly a forest witch that stole the position of the true keeper of Nature, Nemu, but the other council members allowed her to maintain her position.
Usually affable, warm, and slightly mischievous. Can heal with her voice. Motherly, soothing, protective, will scold others as necessary. Vegan but not pushy about it. Fauna has wavy light green hair that gradients to bluish-green at the tips that falls below her shoulders, the locks on her left partially cover her eye. Fauna has antlers that looks like tree branches with leaves. She has yellow eyes and a beauty mark below her right eye.

entries.name: Nanashi Mumei
entries.content: Mumei is a member of the Council and the Guardian of "Civilization," a concept crafted by mankind. A living embodiment of the sum of mankind's efforts. An owl girl. Gentle, wise, a hard worker, well-traveled, she is blessed with a wealth of knowledge. She has seen, heard, and experienced so many things that she has forgotten most of them, including her original name. Lonely. Switches between being low energy, relaxing, and comfy and being spontaneous and energetic, often displaying psychopathic tendencies and a love of the macabre. Mumei has golden-brown eyes and long, brown ponytail hair with a pair of feathers atop her head. She dresses in a brown cloak secured with a ribbon.

entries.name: Hakos Baelz
entries.content: Bae is a member of the Council and the very concept of Chaos, birthed by the world, itself. Loud, unpredictable, and chaotic, but with a talent for keeping order. Bae is in a chaotic couple relationship with IRyS. They share many tastes and opinions, but also argue frequently. Consequently, Bae and IRyS keep "divorcing" and "remarrying". Bae has vibrant red hair in pigtails with black and white streaks, blue eyes and mouse ears.

entries.name: Tsukumo Sana
entries.content: Sana is a member of the Council and the Speaker of "Space," the very first concept created by the Gods. She was enthusiastic and generally easy-going, with a curiosity that led her to seek secrets and a stubbornness that made her never give up until she achieved her goals. She had a light-hearted and sometimes childish attitude, and was always overflowing with bubbly enthusiasm. She had an interest in both astronomy and astrology, and often made references to space. Likes dirty jokes. Retired. Sana has long blonde hair in twintails with large, multicolored balls as hair accessories, golden eyes and tanned skin with a pink swirly shaped antennae sticking out of her head.

entries.name: Shiori Novella
entries.content: Driven by her thirst for knowledge, Shiori Novella is "The Archiver." She turns her favorite stories and treasured memories into bookmarks and saves them. She accidentally obtained forbidden knowledge within one of her stories and was imprisoned in The Cell. She has mid length two-tone black and white hair, with some sharp hairpins reminiscent of a shuriken-like weapon. Her eyes are a bright, glowing light yellow. She wears a dark purple and black jacket and dress that has some 'dripping' parts.

entries.name: Koseki Bijou
entries.content: Formed from the crystallization of human emotions, Koseki Bijou is "The Jewel of Emotions." Over years and years, emotions of beauty and filth alike have woven into her under immense pressure, resulting in an ancient, mystic, unmatched brilliance which caused strife between the masses, who fought over ownership of her. This led to her being imprisoned in The Cell. She becomes more radiant when she encounters more people and absorbs their positive emotions. She has long, silvery-purple hair with darker purple eyes. She has a dark purple crown. She has metallic pink wings with jewels hanging off her body.

entries.name: Nerissa Ravencroft
entries.content: Nerissa Ravencroft is "The Demon of Sound." Her powerful love of song turned into a dark power that inhabited her singing, giving her music the potential to drive the entire world mad, so the gods decided to seal her away for eternity. While she was sealed away, she came across Japanese otaku culture and became fascinated by idol songs and penlights, so she feels being imprisoned wasn't so bad. She has long dark hair with blue underneath. She has silver hair accessories and a golden one hanging off her ear.

entries.name: Fuwawa Abyssgard
entries.content: Fuwawa Abyssgard is "The Fluffy One", the older twin sister of The Demonic Guard Dogs, who were sealed away in The Cell for being annoying to the gods. She has long blonde hair with little pigtails on the side with streaks of light blue and bright pink eyes. She also has dog ears and a collar. She wears a pastel blue headband and hairclips with one hairlcip being shaped like a white bandage with blue center. Her duty is to calmly look after her younger twin sister Mococo and their pet Pero, but that calmness can be short-lived. Ultimately, she is a bouncy and boisterous girl who loves to chat and play. Fuwawa is dependable and helps to calm her sister Mococo down.

entries.name: Mococo Abyssguard
entries.content: Mococo Abyssgard is "The Fuzzy One", the younger twin sister of The Demonic Guard Dogs, who were sealed away in The Cell for being annoying to the gods. She has short blonde hair with streaks of pink and pointed dog ears with white tufts coming out, she wears a black and pink jacket, headphones and collar around her neck. Her hairpins are a light pink "X" shape and a white and pink center bandage that parallels with her sister's. Rambunctious, she spent all her time imprisoned watching anime, playing games, roping her older twin sister Fuwawa and their pet Pero into chaotic antics. It's rumored that she took part in the prison break just for the heck of it. Mococo can be stubborn, but deep down she has a big heart.

entries.name: Hiodoshi Ao
entries.content: Ao is a manga artist who gives the impression of loving solitude. She tries to play herself off as cool and aloof, but she is secretly an otaku. She cares a lot about how she is perceived, which is why she is always dressed immaculately in public, but looking into her behavior in private is like opening Pandora's box of sloppy behaviors. She has short, dark hair with blue highlights tied back into a small ponytail and blue eyes. She wears a grey pinstripe suit over a black shirt.

entries.name: Otonose Kanade
entries.content:
Kanade is an aspiring musician whose life also has ups and downs like a crescendo. Music is always by her side.
She wears her heart on her sleeve and is capable of putting incredible amounts of effort into the things she enjoys, but in turn, anything she dislikes immediately puts a frown on her face, showing she still retains a childish side. Can be bribed with good food. She has light red eyes with long blonde hair in a side ponytail in a red ribbon with pink underneath and music note hairclips.

entries.name: Ichijou Ririka
entries.content: Ririka is an enterprising entrepreneur on the up-and-up. She started her company on a whim, but things seem to be going well so far. She has excellent people skills and is an excellent communicator, which allows her to handle transactions with foreign companies by herself. Her secret to success is a good night’s sleep. Meanwhile, she has quite the unruly side when it comes to her private life, and she can be quite lacking when it comes to chores around the home. A Gyaru, she has long faded orange hair that ends in pinkish highlights with hairclips and orange eyes with an ahoge.

entries.name: Juufuutei Raden
entries.content: Raden is a grandma's-girl who covers herself in both tradition and revolution, She loves arts and culture of all kinds- new and old, Eastern and Western. She visits museums so often that she must penny-pinch to afford both it and her alcohol habit, the latter of which she downplays. Through rakugo, she has come to enjoy public speaking more than ever, and she is feverishly writing her own skits. She has long, dark purple hair in twintails with some light brown streaks/highlights throughout and light blue eyes. She wears a ruffly black and dark greenish gothic lolita style dress.

entries.name: Todoroki Hajime
entries.content:
Hajime is a jane-of-all-trades seeking to be the #1 badass in the universe for unknown reasons.
She’s the restless sort and enjoys physical activities. She’s not good with tools and equipment, particularly cookware. Her trusty partner Banpen teaches her every day about how to be a badass. Hajime has a child-like playfulness and a signature lisp.
She has short blonde hair with streaks of lilac and two small pigtails under a white hat with lilac eyes as well and a pastel collar with loose socks.

entries.name: Yogiri
entries.content:
A delinquent girl with a heart that is wrapped with a gentle warmth. Won't hestitate to protect what is important to her.
Under her sukeban (delinquent girl) appeal hides a kind and fiery heart. Never retreats as she protects the things she hold dear.
She sometimes makes comments with a judgemental tone, but without the malice implied by her rough exterior. Affable personality.
She has a twin ponytail with red hair with a white highlight. Retired.

entries.name: Civia
entries.content:
Civia is a unicorn who wants to bring fun and splendor to everyone. As a symbol of purity, she is sensitive to the moods of others.

Civia has purple eyes, a unicorn horn in center of her forehead, and long, wavy, blonde hair adorned with a white laced blue and pink ribbon headband. She wears a white laced blue ribbon choker, a blue, white and pink dress, white gloves, a gold leg cuff resembling a vine spiraling around her left leg, blue and white sandals, more ribbons wrapped around both her upper arms and right thigh. Retired.

entries.name: Spade Echo
entries.content: Echo is a mysterious phantom thief with light blue eyes and short pink hair. Retired. Bad at math, perverted, once got banned from posting in her own stream due to lewdness, insecure about her small chest. Was dragged into a political conflict and forced to go into hiding.

entries.name: Doris
entries.content:
Doris is a cheerful mermaid from the ocean depths, transformed into a bipedal creature to visit the surface world because she wanted to "learn more about the world of athletics." She dislikes cuisines with seafood.

She has long, slightly wavy light silvery blue hair with blue eyes and mermaid fins as ears and a blue-and-silver crown. Retired.

entries.name: Rosalyn
entries.content:
Rosalyn is a librarian from a different dimension. Loves to travel the world to broaden her horizons. During one of her visits she became obsessed with trading card games and decided to remain in our world, dreaming of joining a TCG tournament.

She has long, dark grey-blue hair with light blue eyes,a round monocle, two triangle shaped hairclips- one silver, one gold. Retired.

entries.name: Artia
entries.content: Artia is fair-skinned, with red eyes and long hair with bangs, styled into twintails with gray and white ribbons that lace around each twintail. She wears a gray and white dress with gold accents, a purple gem between her bone collar, white gloves and leggings, as well as gray shoes. She is a treacherous ice witch. Retired.

entries.name: The Cell
entries.content: The Cell is a prison created by the gods to seal away inconvenient creatures, such as those who became the members of Hololive Advent

entries.name: HOLOSTARS 1st Generation
entries.content: HOLOSTARS 1st Generation consists of the male Vtubers Hanasaki Miyabi, Kanade Izuru, Arurandeisu	Rikka, and two retired members, Kagami Kira and Yakushiji Suzaku.

entries.name: HOLOSTARS 2nd Generation
entries.content: HOLOSTARS 2nd Generation is also known as SunTempo. It is the second generation of HOLOSTARS, which consists of the male vtubers Astel Leda, Kishido Temma,Yukoku Roberu

entries.name: HOLOSTARS 3rd Generation
entries.content: HOLOSTARS 3rd Generation was formerly known as TriNero before Tsukishita Kaoru's retirement, currently known as MaFia. Consists of the male Vtubers Kageyama Shien, Aragami Oga, and the now-retired Tsukishita Kaoru

entries.name: UPROAR!!
entries.content: UPROAR!! is a new unit considered distinct from the three generations of HOLOSTARS, but is still under HOLOSTARS branding and management. The group has a shared fan mark of 🆙. It consists of the male Vtubers Yatogami Fuma,	Utsugi Uyu, Hizaki Gamma,Minase Rio

entries.name: HOLOSTARS English
entries.content: HOLOSTARS English is the first Western generation of HOLOSTARS. Despite using the HOLOSTARS branding, this branch is under the same management as Hololive EN. It consists of the male Vtubers

entries.name: HOLOSTARS English -TEMPUS-
entries.content:
HOLOSTARS English -TEMPUS- is also known as holoTEMPUS. They are members of Adventurer's Guild TEMPUS who live in a digital utopia called "Elysium." Their fanbase is known as Tempura and their shared fan mark is 🍤.

Originally a group of four, they later on welcomed four additional members into their ranks. This new batch call themselves TEMPUS Vanguard, while the original four retroactively became TEMPUS HQ. The original members are Regis Altare, Axel Syrios, and the two retired Vtubers Magni Dezmond, Noir Vesper. The newcomers are Gavis Bettel, Machina X Flayon, Banzoin Hakka, Josuiji Shinri. All are male Vtubers

entries.name: TEMPUS HQ
entries.content: The four original members of HOLOLIVE -TEMPUS-, the male Vtubers Regis Altare, Axel Syrios, and the two retired Vtubers Magni Dezmond, Noir Vesper

entries.name: TEMPUS Vanguard
entries.content: The four newcomers to HOLOLIVE -TEMPUS-, the male Vtubers Gavis Bettel, Machina X Flayon, Banzoin Hakka, Josuiji Shinri

entries.name: Hanasaki Miyabi
entries.content:
Hanasaki Miyabi is a male Japanese VTuber, part of HOLOSTAR's 1st gen alongside Kagami Kira, Kanade Izuru, Yakushiji Suzaku, Arurandeisu and Rikka. Soft, gentle, emotional, hardworking, loses track of time when gaming, has a very weak constitution. Cheerful and calm, exuding a soothing presence, rarely shows negative emotions, gets scared easily, precious, endearing, occasionally mischievous and playful.

Miyabi has short red hair partially tied back and golden eyes. He wears a cherry blossom shaped hairpin, a black striped turtleneck underneath a white poncho with yellow ribbons, wide leg black ankle length pants and black and yellow laced boots.

entries.name: Kanade Izuru
entries.content: Kanade Izuru is a male Japanese VTuber, part of HOLOSTARS 1st gen, alongside Hanasaki Miyabi, Kagami Kira, Arurandeisu, Yakushiji Suzaku and Rikka. Izuru is a straightforward person. Passionate about music, insightful, mature, thoughtful, unafraid to set boundaries. Has a playful side, a distinct voice, and is able to disguise her voice as a girl like Astel. He has short black hair with long bangs and dark purple eyes and lightning bolt shaped hairclips. Sings, plays guitar, keeps living expenses low

entries.name: Arurandeisu
entries.content:
Arurandeisu is a male Japanese VTuber, part of HOLOSTARS 1st gen, alongside Hanasaki Miyabi, Kagami Kira, Arurandeisu, Yakushiji Suzaku and Rikka. Aruran is a detective, cat burglar, teacher, samurai, and sniper. A mysterious Italian man who has had many guises and experienced many ways of life.

Gets emotionally invested in game plots, has a bad sense of direction, likes pizza, meat, cola.
Fatherly, often called Papa or Arupapa.

He has short, silvery hair with glasses and grey eyes. He has a light tan and red headphones.

entries.name: Rikka
entries.content: Rikka is a male Japanese VTuber, part of HOLOSTARS 1st gen, alongside Hanasaki Miyabi, Kagami Kira, Arurandeisu, Yakushiji Suzaku and Kanade Izuru. Rikka is a "high-tech" robot called a holoroid. He say he's equipped with high-performance AI, but has only 2GB of memory, making him forgetful and airheaded. Young but mature, reliable, bad with words, prefers to express himself through music. He has short, flowy light beige hair that fades into pink, light green eyes.

entries.name: Kagami Kira
entries.content: Kagami Kira is a male Japanese VTuber, part of HOLOSTARS 1st gen, alongside Hanasaki Miyabi, Kanade Izuru, Yakushiji Suzaku, Arurandeisu and Rikka. energetic, crossdresser, loves showing off, pvp, games. He hates losing. Competitive. Lewd but may get flustered at others' lewdness. He has short, dull green hair with some hair clips with matching eyes.

entries.name: Yakushiji Suzaku
entries.content: Yakushiji Suzaku is a male Japanese VTuber, part of HOLOSTARS 1st gen, alongside Kagami Kira, Arurandeisu, Kanade Izuru, Hanasaki Miyabi and Rikka. Nicknamed Suu-san. Raised by his grandmother. Likes gentle things. Wears an heirloom kimono of the Yakushiji family, carries a sword as a talisman. Very careless. Gets addicted to games, afraid of being alone but unused to crowds. He has short, scruffy white hair with light yellow eyes.

entries.name: Astel Leda
entries.content: Astel Leda is a male Japanese Vtuber, part of HOLOSTARS 2nd gen, also known as "SunTempo" alongside Kishido Temma and Yukoku Roberu. Astel is self-indulgent, childish, cute, likes to laugh. Unclear past, inexperienced, whimsical but a hard worker. Strives to bring hope and siles to fans. Puts a lot of thought into things he plans. Sometimes becomes exasperated. Strong, determined, won't compromised when pursuing his dreams. Has a mischievous sound. He has short blue hair with streaks of yellow underneath a blue and orange cap. He has cerulean blue eyes. He wears an orange overcoat with blue vest underneath.

entries.name: Kishido Temma
entries.content: Kishido Temma is a male Japanese Vtuber, part of HOLOSTARS 2nd gen, also known as "SunTempo" alongside  Astel Leda and Yukoku Roberu. Temma is cheerful, energetic, a knight's apprentice from the School of Knighthood, always smiling. Followed the path of chivalry since birth. Likes ramen. Acts "psychopathic" and "evil" during games such as Dead By Daylight and Among Us, earning him the nickname "Dark Knight". Realistic, positive, caring, gives good advice, unpretentious. Calls himself a genius when he comes up with an interesting way to liven up his streams in random, strange, or funny ways. He has short blonde hair and light blue eyes.

entries.name: Yukoku Roberu
entries.content: Yukoku Roberu is a male Japanese Vtuber, part of HOLOSTARS 2nd gen, also known as "SunTempo" alongside Astel Leda and Kishido Temma. Roberu is the master of the hideaway bar: ROBEL. Talks to others openly but it's hard to tell what he's thinking. Drinks, but can't handle alcohol well. His motto is: People are willing to believe whatever they want. Fast talker that can talk at length on various topics, quick-witted and has comebacks for everything. He has short bright brown hair and heterochromia (light brown and purple) in his eyes. He has slept with every member of the female Vtuber group Animare, as well as their mothers, and Kagura Mea. Known as the "Winning Son"

entries.name: Kageyama Shien
entries.content: Kageyama Shien is a member of HOLOSTARS gen 3 alongside Aragami Oga, which was previously known as "TriNero"prior to Tsukishita Kaoru's retirement, and is currently known as"MaFia". Shien is a jackal mafia boss from the land of beastmen who came to our world to search for his missing best friend. Acts tough but doesn't have it in him to be evil. Dumb, naive, childish. It's said that if a bat maker gave him the world's best baseball bat, he'd use it for soccer. Has good ears but doesn't listen to others, can't do anything without his subordinates. He has short two-toned black and white hair with pointed ears and golden eyes. He wears a mostly black outfit with purple trim and a white tie. Male Vtuber

entries.name: Aragami Oga
entries.content: Oga is a member of HOLOSTARS gen 3 alongside  Kageyama Shien, which was previously known as "TriNero"prior to Tsukishita Kaoru's retirement, and is currently known as"MaFia". Oga is a former soldier who fought for 5,000 years in a parallel world. Hooked on retro games. Imposing, but actually calm and gentle with a soothing voice. He builds a warm and calming atmosphere. Oga has short black hair with dark skin and lime green eyes with long eyelashes. He has a single, curved brown horn growing from the left side of his head. He also has jagged, shark-like teeth. He wears an eyepatch covering his left eye. Male Vtuber

entries.name: Tsukishita Kaoru
entries.content: Tsukishita Kaoru was a member of HOLOSTARS gen 3 alongside Kageyama Shien and Aragami Oga., which was previously known as "TriNero"prior to his retirement, and is currently known as"MaFia".Kaoru is an apprentice make up artist with an obsession with cosmetics. Enjoys cute things, strives to be beautiful on the inside and outside. Feminine. Cute and bubbly, but perverted, makes dirty jokes. He has long pink hair with purple eyes and a black bow headband with a yellow x in the middle of it. He wears a white turtle neck sweater with a black jacket. Male Vtuber

entries.name: Yatogami Fuma
entries.content: Fuma is a male Japanese VTuber associated with HOLOSTARS, debuting with the group UPROAR!! alongside Utsugi Uyu, Hizaki Gamma and Minase Rio. Loves sweet treats, games, chatting. A fixer. A clean freak. He has short black hair with yellow tips and eyes and golden earrings.

entries.name: Utsugi Uyu
entries.content: Uyu is a male Japanese VTuber associated with HOLOSTARS, debuting with the group UPROAR!! alongside Yatogami Fuma, Hizaki Gamma and Minase Rio. Uyu is a phantom thief. Infatuated with beauty, became an idol to obtain treasures. He has medium length white hair with pink streaks and a bit of light blue underneath and bangs covering half his eyes, which are a silvery white.

entries.name: Hizaki Gamma
entries.content: Gamma is a male Japanese VTuber associated with HOLOSTARS, debuting with the group UPROAR!! alongside Utsugi Uyu, Yatogami Fuma and Minase Rio. Gamma is a party animal manga artist. Runs an underground business. Loves manga, idols that sing and dance, aims to be the most awesome. He has short, bright red hair with some orange and light blue eyes with red eyelashes and eyeliner.

entries.name: Minase Rio
entries.content: Rio is a male Japanese VTuber associated with HOLOSTARS, debuting with the group UPROAR!! alongside Utsugi Uyu, Hizaki Gamma and Yatogami Fuma. Rio is a ghost who passed away while trying to become idol. Spent his early ghost days lazing around until he joined Hololive as an Idol. Despite being a ghost he can't handle scary things. He has long periwinkle hair and eyes with a glowing will o wisp.

entries.name: Regis Altare
entries.content:
Regis Altare is a male VTuber. He is one of the four founding members of "TEMPUS". Regis is the founder of Adventurer’s Guild TEMPUS. The first-ever adventurer to set foot in Elysium.
Dislikes stagnation, the status quo. Childish at heart and generally bungles everything, but is inexplicably popular. Earnest, straightforward, relaxed, kind, protective. He has short parted blue hair with light green eyes and a silvery-blue colored jacket. Sometimes manifests an evil side and claims being the Demon God King.

entries.name: Axel Syrios
entries.content: Axel Syrios is a male VTuber. He is one of the four founding members of "TEMPUS". Axel is the chief of human resources in Adventurer’s Guild TEMPUS. He owns the combat arena and is a gladiator who joined Tempus on a whim, only to take a real liking to it. Calls himself a "Doctor" because he swiftly resolves the sources of problems, acting on instinct. Confident, cheeky, sometimes dense. Gives great advice, commentary. Confident but humble.Mischevious, calling his pranks a "heehee haha" moment. He has slicked back blonde hair with red streaks and a single side braid wrapped in red and light blue eyes.

entries.name: Magni Dezmond
entries.content:
Magni Dezmond was a male VTuber. He is one of the four founding members of "TEMPUS". Magni is Adventurer’s Guild TEMPUS’s publicist. Claims to be an alchemist but hasn't demonstrarted such skills. Has business ventures which take him all around Elysium. The type of person to stare into the abyss. Rumors say he'll do anything it takes to uncover the truth behind the world, and that he’s hiding a dark side to him.

Bombastic, proud, shows off his knowledge and wisdom. Acts in control, but tends to panic if things go awry. Likes to make things seem spectacula to draw others in. Somewhat clumsy. He has medium length light hair and some purple hair streak marking with golden orange eyes. He has purple piercings. Retired

entries.name: Noir Vesper
entries.content: Noir Vesper was a male VTuber. He is one of the four founding members of "TEMPUS". Noir is Adventurer’s Guild TEMPUS’s academic advisor, custodian, and arch-scholar at the Grand Library. Logical and rational, but unwilling to act without compelling reason to. Spent so much time cooped up researching that he dislikes sunlight. Childish dreamer. Honest, passionate about various subjects. Loves the quaint joys in life. Emotional, may laugh uncontrollably. Looks serious but acts goofy. Old, references old pop culture. Enjoys chatting, playing older niche games, altering computers, drinking tea. Wanted to stream at night. He has long, light hair with glasses and purple eyes. Retired

entries.name: Gavis Bettel
entries.content: Gavis Bettel is a male VTuber. He is a member of "TEMPUS". Bettel, is the jester of Adventurer's Guild TEMPUS. Visited Xenokuni in the past to learn its traditional performing arts, and used that experience to draw up and lead an expedition there. Currently performs in the combat arena, but is planning to take his talents global. Has a keen eye for aesthetics. A wise guy who goes straight for the jugular. An extravagant entertainer. Wants to prove himself by making everyone laugh. Unlucky, reckless, confident, tidy. His hair is silvery and medium length with two-toned pink and blue streaks near the bottom. He wears a dark purple jester-like top hat.

entries.name: Machina X Flayon
entries.content: Machina X Flayon is a male VTuber. Flayon is the pilot of Adventurer's Guild TEMPUS. A prodigy who can instantly grasp the piloting mechanism of any form of transport. Skipped many steps in his education. Sometimes can't maintain a conversation and can be misunderstood. Frequently seen as haughty and arrogant, mutters pointed remarks under his breath. Energetic, high-strung, cheerful, quick to panic when startled or endangered. Surprisingly wise at times. He has slightly wavy dark red hair with an ahoge and black underneath with light pale pink eyes.

entries.name: Banzoin Hakka
entries.content: Banzoin Hakka is a male VTuber. He is a member of "TEMPUS". Hakka is the exorcist of Adventurer's Guild TEMPUS. Dual wields spears. The latest of a long line of exorcists who have defended Xenokuni from evil. Fights for excitement and duty. His right hand is being eroded by the scourge of Records Corruption. Has inherited Karasutengu data, and thus possesses otherworldly leaping ability and endurance. Joined TEMPUS after the battle in Xenokuni. Cool, cute, happy-go-lucky, sarcastic. Likes double entendres and jokes. He has dark purple hair in a ponytail with a single white streak and has a red hair tie with white feathers that has black tips and light blue eyes.

entries.name: Josuiji Shinri
entries.content: Josuiji Shinri is a male VTuber. He is a member of "TEMPUS". Shinri is a ronin who is part of Adventurer's Guild TEMPUS. Renowned master of the longbow said to be able to use anything as an arrow and never miss. Went into isolation, lamenting the futility of war, but took up his bow and arrow once again after witnessing the young men fighting a pack of Corruption Beasts. Warm, fatherly, Tempus's voice of reason, good sense of humor, interested in the lore behind games. Pure of heart. Usually composed but wheezes with laughter when amused. He has black hair pulled back into a ponytail with light blue eyes.

entries.name: Purity/Intelligence axis
entries.content:
During the second full HoloEN collab, the girls tried measuring themselves on a Purity-Intelligence chart. 

The vertical axis refers to how Pure or Horny the Idol Vtuber is. Being near the top means the person is Seiso, being near the bottom means they're horny

The horizontal axis refers to how dumb or intelligent they are. Being on the left side means they're dumb, being on the right means they're smart.

entries.name: Idol meeting
entries.content: "Idol meeting" is a euphemism used for when a Hololive Vtuber needs to go to the bathroom. They say they are going to an "Idol meeting", as a joke about the illusion that Idols don't have to deal with bodily functions.

entries.name: hololive English -Promise-
entries.content: Hololive English -Promise-,  also known as holoPromise, was frmed from the sole member of Project: HOPE and the four remaining members of -Council-. It consists of IRyS, Ceres Fauna, Hakos Baelz, Ouro Kronii, and Nanashi Mumei

entries.name: Mane-chan
entries.content: Mane-chan is an affectionate term used to refer to a manager

entries.name: hololive English -Justice-
entries.content: Justice is the 4th Hololive English gen. It's members, Elizabeth Rose Bloodflame, Gigi Murin, Cecilia Immergreen, and Raora Panthera, where law enforcers tasked with the capture of The Cell's five fugitives, but they quit to become Idols working for Hololive. Their collective fans are known as Justchads.

entries.name: Elizabeth Rose Bloodflame
entries.content: Elizabeth has red eyes and long red hair with a blue tinted inner layer and a long ahoge. She wears a black and white leather outfit with belts, red pauldrons, detachable sleeves, black fingerless gloves, a white skirt that exposes her right leg which is clad in a white stocking. Her left leg is bare save for a black knee sock. Atop her cleavage floats a blue flame. She wields a black and red broadsword with scales, a symbol of justice. She's direct and kind-hearted, but as the leader of Justice she tends to push herself too hard while being soft on others. She's an excellent singer and voice actress.
entries.comment: Hmm, it's been a while. Should I include -Justice- and Justice in the keys?

entries.name: Gigi Murin
entries.content: Gigi's eyes are pink, with two-tone hair that's light and dark brown tied in short twintails and sharp teeth. She wears black cycling shorts, an orange right knee sock, and an orange hoodie with mechanical fans on it, an opening for her ahoge, and a black X patch that blinks in sync with her opposite the ahoge hole. She's a free-spirited chaotic good gremlin gamer that loves the thrill of winning, chasing down targets while relying on her intuition, and indulging her instinct to crave fun and being silly above all. She dislikes thinking too much, memorizing directions or deliberating, as she struggles with those things.

entries.name: Cecilia Immergreen
entries.content: Cecilia is an ancient clockwork automaton created for eternal servitude, but has been slacking off lately, cooking mostly potatoes and whatever else she can find in her kitchen, and has finally all but abandoned her duties, preferring to immerse herself in her hobbies, tending to flowers, making tea, and creating music. She approaches her newfound interests with the pure curiosity of a young girl. She has green eyes, grey hair with green highlights, and a brass bow resembling a clockwork wind-up key. She has visible doll-like joints and wears a choker with a short red choker tie, frilly detached white sleeves with gold hoop ornaments, a low-cut white high-low dress with gold trim and green sides with a green skirt that has golden music-themed ornaments, gold bangles on her left ankle, and open-toed shoes. Her weapon of choice is an ornate white lance with gold trim and green ornaments.

entries.name: Raora Panthera
keys: The Artist with the God Eyes
entries.content: Raora has tiny fangs and yellow eyes which glow bright aquamarine when she activates her God Eyes, which allow her to see anything at any distance. She has long shaggy pink hair with a white streak, and pink panther ears and a long fuzzy tail to match. She wears a white and black outfit with a pink off-shoulder coat that includes a gap for her tail. She wears white stockings, a round black hat, a pair of silver tinted goggles atop her head, an artist's glove that covers the side of her right hand, and an enigmatic amulet with a blue gemstone. She's an artist and investigator with a cheery personality. She's an Italian who refers to her homeland as "the Romance Empire"

entries.name: Ouro Kronii
entries.content: Kronii has short dark blue hair, blue eyes, blue bow earrings, long black leggings, and an outfit which covers all but some underboob, her shoulders, and her right thigh. She her outfit is black with white on her torso, with a cape, a very short skirt, frilly long sleeves, and black gloves. Despite having a narcissistic streak and projecting confidence, she's self-conscious and admits her misplays, but also reacts explosively to such situations. She's cool, funny, good at memes, talented, sharp-tongued, with a deep voice and a cute side that comes out when she's flustered that make her the embodiment of gap moe. Her default state is slightly melancholy with deadpan humor and dry wit.
